description:
You're now in the kitchen. Okay, just remember what you're here to do, and everything will go great.

You can see a closed fridge. You make out a closed oven. Look out! It's a- oh, never mind, it's just a table. The table is massive. On the table you make out a cookbook. You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a counter. I guess it's true what they say, if you're looking for a counter, go to TextWorld. The counter is vast.
